purpose: Read-only native GIMP kinematic diagnostic before another full resolution trial; no simulated motion, stability factor or scientific validation
unchanged: Actual SRF1.6 perfect Cauchy MC composite-apex law, polygon, grid extent, PPC2, fixed basal xy/side x rollers and every solver/loading assignment; constructors only

prescribedField.classification: Hypothetical nodal kinematic sampling, never actual MPM velocities or best approximation
prescribedField.movingRegion: entry<=x<=exit AND lowerArc(x)<y<=surface(x); strict arc equality uses stationary side
prescribedField.velocityMPerS: ((cy-y)/R,(x-cx)/R) inside cap, otherwise zero; unit magnitude on arc only
prescribedField.maskApplication: Apply actual bc-fixed component masks to temporary nodal values only; zero is constrained, nil is free
prescribedField.gradient: Actual non-Fbar native GIMP gradient; no normalization of weights or gradients
prescribedField.interpretation: Pointwise jump errors include finite-domain/nodal sampling smear; they do not prove grid locking or an engine defect

particleDomains.actualInitialParticles: Reported separately, including physical x>2m,y>2m cohort flag
particleDomains.hypotheticalProbes: Not inserted into sim; domain crossing grid floor is explicitly NON_ADMISSIBLE_AS_INITIAL_MP even if center inside
particleDomains.kernelSupport: Full kernel support is distinct from finite MP-domain clearance; report raw partition and signed gradients without renormalizing
particleDomains.outsideGridCenters: NOT_EVALUATED_CENTER_OUTSIDE_GRID; no native iterator call or coordinate clamp

controls.fullSupport: Constant and general affine field reproduction at (4.125h,4.375h), half-domain h/4
controls.zeroBase: Prescribed ux=y,uy=0 sampled on native nodes, temporary y0 probes with half-domain l; sumW=1-l/(4h), baseW=1-l/(2h), represented ux=l/4, d(ux)/dy=1/2; floor-crossing hypothetical probes, not actual MPs
controls.forbiddenCalls: Actual around-method counters trap all update-sim and composite constitutive-model attempts; require zero

limitations: Retained formal circle has negative normal forces and is not a physical/global FoS
Fixed base is an actual physical anchoring assumption, not an interpolation defect
No trajectory, factor search, stress update, convergence proof, slide detection or automatic next-run authorization
A hypothetical domain crossing the floor may have truncated partition; this is not evidence that actual initial MPs lose support
